Body.Content:
The Azure Network Watcher Connection Troubleshoot, previously in preview as Connectivity Check, is making general availability sporting a new name. This feature helps to drastically reduce the amount of time needed to find and detect connectivity issues in the infrastructure. The results returned can provide valuable insights into whether a connectivity issue is due to a platform, or a potential user configuration. Network Watcher Connection Troubleshoot can be used from the Azure portal, using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and REST API.

​Learn more about Azure Network Watcher.
